# Prado U-Boot environment
# Source: live NAND MTD3 dump (mtd3_env.bin) + UART printenv capture
# Base:   Holden firmware package uboot-env.bin

baudrate=115200
backlight=30
bootcmd=run nandboot
bootdelay=9
bootfile=zImage
carback_camera_mode=0
loadaddr=0x1000000
mmcboot=run setbootargs ; fatload mmc ${mmcdev} ${loadaddr} ${bootfile}; bootz ${loadaddr}
mmcdev=1
mtddevname=S-Loader
mtddevnum=0
mtdids=nand0=ark1680-nand
mtdparts=mtdparts=ark1680-nand:128k(S-Loader),512k(U-boot),512k(U-boot_back),256K(U-boot-Env),256K(arkdata),4m(kernel),106m(rootfs),6m(userdata),512K(bootlogo),3m(bootanimation),3m(reversingtrack),256K(Unicode)
nandboot=run setbootargs ; bootnand
nand_erasesize=20000
nand_oobsize=40
nand_writesize=800
partition=nand0,0
screen=0
setbootargs=setenv bootargs console=ttyS0,115200n8 mem=180M earlyprintk=serial ubi.mtd=6 root=ubi0:rootfs rootfstype=ubifs rootwait ro ${mtdparts} screen=${screen}
spiboot=run setbootargs ; bootspi
stderr=serial
stdin=serial
stdout=serial
updatereset=yes

# Size tracking variables — recorded from live device, written by update tool at flash time
# These are informational; not required for the env to function
# U-boot_back_size=0x5bc88
# U-boot_size=0x5bc88
# arkdata_size=0x1a0f
# bootanimation_size=0x511c
# bootlogo_size=0x6c1f
# kernel_size=0x305130
# reversingtrack_size=0x96a58
# rootfs_size=0x5aa0000
# userdata_size=0x1e0000
